The '''Nebulon-series''' was a line of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] that was produced by [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet Swoops and Speeders]]. The line included the [[Nebulon-Q Swoop Racer]], the [[Nebulon-R Racer]], and the [[Nebulon-S Racer]].<ref name="Stay on Target">[[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']]</ref>
